status: Built from the data site's feeds on {read}. A feed read more than {hours} hours before that is not shown, so a stale warning is never shown as live.
stale: Not shown: this feed was last read on {read}, more than {hours} hours ago. See IPMA for the current picture: https://www.ipma.pt/en/
missing: Not shown: this feed has not been read.
none: IPMA has no warning active in the last read.
sea_head: | Coast | Wave height (m) | Direction | Sea temperature (°C) |
cam: Camera: [{name}]({page}), {credit}. A link to the operator's own page; listed {read}.
source: *Source: IPMA, [ipma.pt](https://www.ipma.pt/en/). Shown on a page with no charge.*
